missing_evidence: The missing metrics are not needed to reject the claim because the predeclared PSNR/L1/static gates already fail.
suggested_claim_revision: R025 shows that the current M1 non-oracle residual-component local refinement can produce checkpoint-backed Gaussian renders, but does not recover the oracle event-crop fix on the five frozen real windows.
